name: r7-mixed-red
why: One red DLL for R7-B-02, R7-B-04, R7-S1 and R7-S2 (docs/review7-live-plan.md, Pre-fix binaries A.2). 9ea4bb2f (S1) reversed whole; B-02(a) the delegate labeller calls {-1,0} stale; B-02(b) the TOptional weak arm says (stale); B-04(a) the sparse element is labelled without the garbage tag; B-04(b) the TOptional resolved name drops its tag; S2 the Find References sparse pass is gated on UE >= 5.0 again. Each reading depends on exactly one of these (the plan's attribution table).

subs.new: if (!named && objIdx == 0 && serial == 0) return "(unbound)";   // STAGING R7-B-02(a) pre-fix

subs.old:
fv.typedValue = optWeakRead ? UnresolvedWeakLabel(optWeakIdx, optWeakSerial)
                                                : DescribeUnreadableField("optional", fi.Offset);
subs.new: fv.typedValue = optWeakRead ? "(stale)" : DescribeUnreadableField("optional", fi.Offset);   // STAGING R7-B-02(b)
const bool sparseEra = ::g_cachedUEVersion >= 500;   // STAGING R7-S2 pre-fix gate
